title: Third 100 low-machine candidates: German→Rarámuri documentary boundary/headword review
provenance_note: AI-assisted documentary collation for the third low-confidence cohort in deterministic source order. The primary Steffel 1809 OCR is preserved and used as primary textual evidence; page/column architecture for pp. 326–333 comes from the repository's previously visually confirmed facsimile layout layer. Merrill et al. (2020, DOI 10.47807/UNISON.8), chapter 8 transcription of the published 1809 version, is used only as a secondary collation aid to resolve OCR-damaged boundaries, headings, and printed-page transitions. Direct facsimile page images were not available in the current runtime, so this batch is explicitly flagged for later direct-image re-collation and is not independent human/philological or linguistic validation.
